purpose: Map recurring work questions to the smallest reusable process source without making VexWork the executor or stealing process ownership from target repositories.

processes.label: Capture discovered work
processes.purpose: Preserve useful adjacent work discovered during another lane without widening that lane or granting implementation authority.
processes.appliesWhen: Current work discovers a useful idea, defect, question, or enhancement that is not required for the current acceptance boundary.

processes.label: Form a VexWork Project
processes.purpose: Turn one human-approved outcome into a durable Project + bounded Workgraph grouping without conflating formation, planning, implementation authority, or provider tickets.
processes.appliesWhen: One coherent outcome has enough related work topology that future humans or agents would otherwise reconstruct grouping, decomposition, routes, or currentness from chat/provider history.

processes.label: Promote a derived concern
processes.purpose: Explicitly decide whether one exact Derived Attention concern creates one canonical Work item or confirms existing Work without automatic ticket generation.
processes.appliesWhen: One exact current entity, Work Lens, Evidence observation, and UNSATISFIED or UNKNOWN reason facet has been selected; existing Work has been reviewed; and an explicit create, confirm, hold, or reject decision is required.

processes.label: VexLife Android feature authoring
processes.purpose: Route admitted Android product-feature work through the repository-owned human-outcome, feature-home, source, and proof formation process.
processes.appliesWhen: A VexLife Android potential or product need is deliberately adopted for feature implementation or major feature evolution.

processes.label: VexWork Quality Review
processes.purpose: Give a fresh QA/reviewer a stable question, evidence, falsification, scope, and disposition contract for one exact candidate without granting merge or provider authority.
processes.appliesWhen: A VexWork candidate or other work-system candidate needs repeatable QA/semantic quality review before a lifecycle or merge decision.

processes.label: Manage reference storefront item
processes.purpose: Route one synthetic public-safe storefront item add/revision through the registered storefront repository without granting VexWork publication authority.
processes.appliesWhen: A synthetic reference storefront item needs known public details or pictures added/revised and published through the rightful storefront owner.

processes.label: Integrate ready pull requests
processes.purpose: Carry already-proven repository candidates through one vigilant serialized Integration Steward queue without making source lanes chase a moving main or granting VexWork merge authority.
processes.appliesWhen: One or more exact pull-request candidates have completed their required candidate-owned proof/review and are ready to be reconsidered against the repository's current integration trunk.

processes.label: Compile VexRelay stage recipe and bind canonical carrier formation
processes.purpose: Route current VexRelay stage compilation and host-carrier package formation through the Vextreme-SDK-owned current contract and Process Atlas so workers resolve the canonical package producer instead of reimplementing or remembering package mechanics.
processes.appliesWhen: A new or unformed VexRelay stage or host carrier package must be formed and the worker needs the current source-managed recipe, task-window formation binding, package producer export, or carrier mechanics without relying on remembered wrapper APIs.
